v1_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Events outside working hours should not be accepted.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Event order should not affect correctness.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_3: No meeting can start during lunch breaks.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Empty list must be output if no slot available.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Event input list must be a list with keys mapped.

v1_human_g3_exception: Work hours are from 9:00 to 17:00 as suggested by the test benches. Time slots are divided/increment every 15 minutes as suggested by test modules. Lunch hours are from 12:00 to 13:00 and no meeting can start during this period.

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: The system should print the output timings on the console for the user.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: The system should print an empty list if no time slots are available.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: The system should only accept valid time slots which fall between typical work hours.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: The system should ensure only acceptable time slots are printed that do not conflict with other events.

v1_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is that it takes in as input a list of existing calendar events for the day as well as the desired meeting duration and the system gives us valid start times at which the meeting can be held/started.
v1_human_g3_input: The input parameters of the system are: Existing calendar Events: List with keys: {"start": "HH:mm"} desired duration: in minutes (String integer type)

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_1: Valid time slot: must always be within work hours and must not conflict with other events.
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_2: Time values must be provided in string data type.
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_3: Function must always return blank/empty list if no slots available.

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: The system must not show an error in case there is no time slot available.
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: The system should not show a non-empty list if no time slot is available.

v1_human_g3_output: The function returns a list of timings at which the meeting can start.
v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: If two scenarios satisfy the same constraints, the system must choose the first acceptable scenario and provide that in the list output.
